title: Development and Validation of a Machine Learning Model to Predict Postoperative Morbidity and Mortality in Patients With COVID-19 Who Underwent Major Surgery.
summary: Machine-learning models including LightGBM predicted 30-day postoperative morbidity and mortality among more than 15,000 COVID-positive surgical procedures. Models trained on 2022 and tested on 2021 data; missing external datasets and selection bias limit generalization.
ai_technology: LightGBM and other supervised models predict a composite postoperative outcome from preoperative features.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: More than 15,000 COVID-positive procedures; 2022 training/2021 testing plus internal validation. Authors note absent external datasets and possible selection bias.
evidence.unknown: External replication and real-world or clinical benefit were not established by the reviewed study; author affiliation is not stated in the reviewed material.
evidence.ai_role: LightGBM and other supervised models predict a composite postoperative outcome from preoperative features.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
